text: DISCHARGED - verified on main by the chief rather than closed on report. SignatureProjection is 'final class SignatureProjection private' at signature.scala:492, not a case class, so the Mirror forge is closed. Its companion carries a validating smart constructor 'of' that rejects empty weight sets and non-finite weights, plus a public 'components' set so a weight set can be checked before it is ever applied - the Scaladoc records what it used to do: empty weights produced Right(0.0), a scalar summary of a signature computed from nothing, and a NaN or infinite weight produced a score that propagated silently through any aggregate. Landed as part of m1's work at 0835c08 and refined through the stack merged at 0b1ceca. NOTE: this closes the CONSTRUCTIBILITY half only. The estimand half - apply returning a bare Double summed from components with unequal support - remains open as bd-01M16BVT725FRQ6AN5GNA3A01W at P2, and closing this bead must not be read as closing that one.
